scope: Admin Proof settings draft safety and default-disabled generic customer catalog integration
activation: disabled; no grants, live imports, settings writes, emails or deployment are included
implementation_contract: Proof settings drafts use the owner's synchronous per-customer controller; pending navigation blocks, known failures retain entries, uncertain outcomes require explicit read-only reconciliation
Explicit UI sign-out uses the existing navigation guard; forced authentication expiry is unchanged
Catalog is lazy loaded only for an explicit frontend customer allowlist and a stable signed-in UID; API independently authorizes verified user grants
Catalog controller binding and component key include customer and operator identity; stale instance cleanup cannot clear a replacement binding
Pending catalog writes block leaving; ordinary preview discard is local; clean unconfirmed journals can leave and remain scoped in browser storage without automatic replay
Switching to another enabled customer preserves Catalog; unavailable Catalog falls back to Overview; existing Artwork Catalog remains a separate tool
Invalid catalog configuration fails catalog routes closed without stopping unrelated API startup
No changes to public Proof/Status runtime, intake/reconciliation workers, canonical order fields or Lift export behavior
remaining_release_gates: Review exact final combined commit and private verification evidence before push/deployment
Preserve existing deployed API compatibility boundaries when packaging; local build success is not permission to replace differing live modules
Verify exact deployed configuration, authenticated grants and permanent storage behavior in an explicitly authorized isolated validation window
Independently verify selected pilot customer and source-record identity; review fresh import preview before real migration
Confirm named internal participants and reader/editor permissions; customer portal, artwork replacement and order submission remain disabled
Agree catalog retention and recovery targets before activation
Obtain explicit pilot activation approval after all gates clear
known_limits: Proof draft recovery is in-memory and survives Settings unmount, not full browser reload or sign-out; native browser close/reload prompt is not independently verified, although the actual beforeunload handler was exercised
Synthetic catalog fixture verifies UI isolation/recovery, not deployed storage persistence
Existing frontend large-chunk build warning remains
No claim of zero possible regression; automated and scoped browser evidence cover the reviewed paths
rollback: Keep gates disabled; revert only reviewed integration code if necessary. Never delete catalog records, immutable blobs, receipts or recovery evidence.
